a.lede: It's been a good week for ULA, with big NASA contract, Vulcan nearing return-to-flight.
a.title: Rocket Report: Winter is coming for Themis; Cowboy Space adds iron to the fire

b.title: ULA's Vulcan rocket is set to return to flight on Friday the 13th
